description: C4 (decision C4-8): Millford's development, smaller than Last Hearth's - its first tier is A3's aftermath (the quarry reopened once Stoneback has fallen and the giant has gone: an auto project, the folk's own work), its second a masons' hall the giant gives it: two cut blocks carried down from the reopened quarry and a slab of the titan's own stone for its lintel.

block.name: quarry block
block.from: the reopened quarry's floor west of Millford, where the quarrymen stack what they cut

tiers.name: The Hamlet
tiers.text: A miller's hamlet under a titan's quarry, its quarrymen idle.

tiers.name: The Quarry Reopened
tiers.text: With Stoneback fallen the quarrymen went back up: cranes, carts and a lit forge that works titan stone.

unlocks.text: Millford's quarry forge works titan stone (the Quarry set).
The stone stall: quarry iron from the pit.

projects.name: The quarry reopened
projects.text: Stoneback held the quarry. With him fallen, the quarrymen go back up behind your back.

tiers.name: The Masons' Hall
tiers.text: A masons' hall of the quarry's own stone stands by the yard, its lintel a slab of the titan.

unlocks.text: The masons trade a slab of Stoneback's stone for three iron ingots.
Masons in from the valleys: Millford's yard is busy.

projects.name: Raise the masons' hall
projects.text: The masons can dress stone but not lift it out of the pit. Two cut blocks from the quarry floor, and a slab of Stoneback's stone over the door - nothing else would do for a lintel in Millford now.
projects.raised_text: The slab drops onto its jambs. The masons cheer and set about the roof.

needs.text: Carry two quarry blocks down to the yard
A slab of Stoneback's stone for the lintel
